exposure: Type of antiseptic used for skin preparation
outcome: Prevalence of surgical-site infection (SSI) after caesarean section
cohort: 729 adult women who underwent caesarean section at Kirehe District Hospital in rural Rwanda
finding: The prevalence of SSI after caesarean section at a rural Rwandan hospital was consistent with rates reported at tertiary facilities in sub-Saharan Africa, and combining antiseptic solutions for skin preparation could potentially reduce the risk.
